content: Hello! how can I help today?
I bought $45K of machinery for my business. What's the most efficient write-off method?
You should combine **Section 179 expensing** with **bonus depreciation** under **IRC §168(k)**. First, expense the full amount via **Form 4562**, Part I. Then apply bonus if any basis remains.
What if I hit the Section 179 limit?
**Bonus depreciation covers the rest** automatically—there’s no income limit for bonus. That’s why many businesses use **both in the same year** for max impact.
Do I have to track depreciation in future years?
Not if you fully expense the item. But if any basis remains, use the **MACRS table** to depreciate the rest using the applicable class life (usually 5 or 7 years).
